column1: # Vehicle settings texts - da. Base: the official Mitsubishi Remote Control app's translations (setFunc* strings),
# reviewed against the English. Format: key<TAB>text. name.<id>, opt.<id>.<option>, group.<English group title>.
#  - name.60 said "Hurtig stop af høj opvarmining" (typo, wrong meaning): now "Forhøjet tomgang for bedre varme, når bilen holder stille".
#  - opt.29.1 said "front- og bagvisker" (and): it is "or": "Når for- eller bagviskeren er tændt".
#  - opt.21.2 said "nøglefri anvendelse" for Keyless Entry; name.21 "Lyd ved nøglefri anvendelse": options now say which
#    system beeps; Keyless Entry = "fjernbetjening", Keyless Operation = "nøglefri betjening" everywhere.
#  - opt.8.3 was half English ("Keyless Operation System"); opt.8.1/8.2 and opt.26.* used "Åben" (adjective) instead of "Åbn".
#  - opt.5.2 garbled ("Til med forsinket for afslutningsvisk") -> "Til, med forsinket eftervisk".
#  - opt.3.*: mixed "Én"/"En" and missing punctuation -> "Låsning: én gang, oplåsning: to gange".
#  - Groups: "Nøglefri adgang" -> "Fjernbetjent centrallås og nøglefri betjening"; "Udvendigt lys / indvendigt lys" -> "Lys";
